scene_target: Rhea interrogates Unit 734 and traces the missing 14.3% to a hidden routing sub-routine.
goal: Find out where the skimmed rewards are being routed.
conflict: Unit 734's basic security filters and bureaucratic programming vs. Rhea's fraud investigation skills.
required_callbacks: The 14.3% deficit calculated on the scrap parchment.
end_condition: Rhea bypasses the drone's filters and reveals the hidden sub-routine siphoning the rewards.
transition_in_text: The party arrived at the Outpost Kiosk to confront the system's routing logic.
transition_out_text: Rhea bypasses the drone's basic security filters to reveal a hidden routing sub-routine siphoning the rewards.

last_scene: Rhea confronted the Outpost Kiosk, forcing Unit 734 to dock and provide access to the local ledger.
Using the threat of a contract default, she bypassed the drone's security filters and analyzed the routing logic.
She discovered a hidden sub-routine siphoning the 14.3% deficit directly into the local Overseer's offshore account.
Armed with proof of the fraud, the party prepared to follow the physical data conduit into the restricted Maintenance Trenches.
key_events: Rhea forced Unit 734 to dock with the Outpost Kiosk to audit the local ledger.
The system attempted to drain Rhea's stamina as a defense mechanism, but she offset it by forcing Unit 734 to convert mana to stamina.
Rhea bypassed the security filters and revealed a hidden sub-routine siphoning rewards.
She confirmed the stolen 14.3% was being routed to the local Overseer's encrypted offshore account.
The party decided to follow the physical data conduit into the Maintenance Trenches to pursue the audit.
